name: Spain total solar eclipse access and activity restrictions — 12 August 2026

metadata.scope: Current published access/traffic/parking/site/forest/wildfire-related restrictions relevant to the Spanish 12 August 2026 total solar eclipse corridor and practical approach routes.
metadata.geometry_policy: geometry is null where no authoritative coordinates/boundary for the restriction were published or embedded; no precise geometry is invented.
metadata.status_policy_note: confirmed = primary/official; reported_confirmed/reported_government_measure = reputable reporting of authority action; planned_not_final = announced but final order pending; conditional = activates only if stated condition occurs; confirmed_existing = ordinary non-eclipse rule active on eclipse day.
metadata.known_data_quality_note: This 2026-08-07 snapshot was rebuilt from the validated 2026-08-05 stable-ID inventory plus a municipality/protected-area/local-press sweep. The erroneous 2026-08-06 placeholder file is not used as source data.
